<UIForeground>F201F8</UIForeground><UIGlow>F201F9</UIGlow>魔烈风效果：<UIGlow>01</UIGlow><UIForeground>01</UIForeground>对目标发动风属性魔法攻击

可习得魔白风
<UIForeground>F201F8</UIForeground><UIGlow>F201F9</UIGlow>魔白风效果：<UIGlow>01</UIGlow><UIForeground>01</UIForeground>恢复自身及周围队员的体力，恢复量等同于自身当前的体力量
习得魔烈风后可习得魔暴风
<UIForeground>F201F8</UIForeground><UIGlow>F201F9</UIGlow>魔暴风效果：<UIGlow>01</UIGlow><UIForeground>01</UIForeground>对目标及其周围的敌人发动风属性范围魔法攻击
